description:
Original use: Bottom part of a state document in Arabic script, containing only the ḥamdala, taṣliya, and ḥasbala. There is also one more word written in the margin at an angle. 

Reused for Hebrew poetry, possibly in the hand of Avraham Ibn Yijū (see separate record).
description_he: מסמך ממלכתי בערבית. מוחזק בספריית קיימברידג'.
